GROUND_WEAPONS_1_3.name: Ground Weapons 1-3
GROUND_WEAPONS_1_3.description: Improves eligible ground-unit weapons; levels 2/3 require Twilight Council and previous level.

GROUND_ARMOR_1_3.name: Ground Armor 1-3
GROUND_ARMOR_1_3.description: Improves ground-unit health armor; levels 2/3 require Twilight Council and previous level.

SHIELDS_1_3.name: Shields 1-3
SHIELDS_1_3.description: Improves shield armor across eligible Protoss units and structures; levels 2/3 require Twilight Council and previous level. Does not add shield capacity.

AIR_WEAPONS_1_3.name: Air Weapons 1-3
AIR_WEAPONS_1_3.description: Improves eligible aircraft weapons; levels 2/3 require Fleet Beacon and previous level.

AIR_ARMOR_1_3.name: Air Armor 1-3
AIR_ARMOR_1_3.description: Improves aircraft health armor; levels 2/3 require Fleet Beacon and previous level.

WARP_GATE.name: Warp Gate
WARP_GATE.description: Unlocks conversion of individual Gateways. Other production buildings remain unchanged.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.description: Unlocks Zealot's closing ability. Does not supply a ranged or anti-air weapon.

BLINK.name: Blink
BLINK.description: Unlocks Stalker teleport. Dark Templar teleport is separate research.

RESONATING_GLAIVES.name: Resonating Glaives
RESONATING_GLAIVES.description: Improves Adept attack speed; no additional anti-air capability.

PSIONIC_STORM.name: Psionic Storm
PSIONIC_STORM.description: Unlocks High Templar's energy-based area spell.

GRAVITIC_DRIVE.name: Gravitic Drive
GRAVITIC_DRIVE.description: Improves Warp Prism movement speed. Does not change it into a Stargate unit.

GRAVITIC_BOOSTERS.name: Gravitic Boosters
GRAVITIC_BOOSTERS.description: Improves Observer movement speed; surveillance remains a separate stationary mode.

ANION_PULSE_CRYSTALS.name: Anion Pulse-Crystals
ANION_PULSE_CRYSTALS.description: Extends Phoenix weapon range. Does not make Phoenix attack ordinary ground targets directly.

TECTONIC_DESTABILIZERS.name: Tectonic Destabilizers
TECTONIC_DESTABILIZERS.description: Improves Tempest damage against structures through its ground-attack specialization.
